skill.name: jutsu-creator
skill.description: Create balanced SHINOBI WAY jutsu and combat skills with guided parameters and TypeScript-ready output.
skill.summary: Guides creation of SHINOBI WAY jutsu definitions for game balance and TypeScript integration.
skill.author: CesarAugustusGroB

content.value_statement: Designing balanced SHINOBI WAY combat skills requires matching many enums, costs, effects, and tier rules. This skill guides requirements gathering and produces TypeScript-ready jutsu definitions.
actual_capabilities: Collects skill name, ID, tier, description, and action type requirements.
Maps jutsu to elements, damage types, damage properties, and attack methods.
Suggests chakra costs, HP costs, cooldowns, scaling stats, and damage multipliers.
Adds effects such as burns, stuns, buffs, debuffs, shields, and chakra drain.
Generates TypeScript-ready skill objects for the game constants file.
Uses included examples and interface references to match existing structures.
limitations: Designed for SHINOBI WAY structures, not general game engines.
Does not run tests or validate generated code inside a project.
Requires user input for balance goals and optional asset paths.
Needs manual review when game enums or interfaces change.

use_cases.title: Design a New Combat Skill
use_cases.description: Create a complete jutsu definition with tier, costs, damage, effects, and requirements.

use_cases.title: Implement Game Data Faster
use_cases.description: Convert a skill concept into a TypeScript object that matches the game constants format.

use_cases.title: Balance Custom Abilities
use_cases.description: Compare cooldowns, resource costs, and damage multipliers against tier guidelines.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Jutsu
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple attack skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Basic main-action fire jutsu for SHINOBI WAY. Ask me for any missing details before generating the final skill.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Elemental Technique
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with combat role and balance constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Advanced lightning jutsu for a ranged attacker. Include costs, cooldown, scaling stat, damage type, and one status effect.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Toggle Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for upkeep and sustained bonuses.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Hidden toggle skill that increases speed and accuracy. Balance activation cost, upkeep cost, cooldown, and counterplay.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert request for review against tier and action rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this jutsu concept for balance and interface fit. Adjust tier, costs, cooldown, effects, and TypeScript fields as needed.

output_examples.input: Create a Basic fire attack for early-game players.
output_examples.output: A Basic main-action fire jutsu with low chakra cost, short cooldown, spirit scaling, elemental damage, and a small burn chance.

output_examples.input: Make a Hidden clan toggle that rewards speed builds.
output_examples.output: A Hidden toggle skill with activation cost, recurring chakra upkeep, speed and accuracy buffs, and clear counterplay through resource pressure.

output_examples.input: Balance a Forbidden ultimate with high risk.
output_examples.output: A Forbidden main-action technique with high chakra and HP costs, long cooldown, strong damage multiplier, and limited reuse.

best_practices: Provide the intended tier, action type, combat role, and target player level.
Review generated values against current game balance before adding them.
Keep side and passive skills focused on utility instead of direct burst damage.
anti_patterns: Do not request a universal skill that ignores tier, cost, and cooldown limits.
Do not add true damage to low-tier skills without a strong design reason.
Do not paste generated output without checking current enums and interfaces.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates SHINOBI WAY jutsu concepts and TypeScript-ready skill definitions.

faq.question: Does it edit my project files?
faq.answer: No. It generates skill definitions for review and manual integration.

faq.question: Can it create passive and toggle skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for main, side, toggle, and passive action types.

faq.question: Can it balance damage and costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses tier tables for damage multipliers, resource costs, and cooldown ranges.

faq.question: Does it support status effects?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add burns, stuns, buffs, debuffs, shields, drains, and similar effects.

faq.question: Who should review the output?
faq.answer: A game designer or developer should review balance, enum names, and interface compatibility.
